propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed that accumulates firing history from sidecar re-review history alone, at zero marginal LLM cost and with no per-criterion wiring.

The recorder appends one firing row per (review-round, finding) to a prune-immune append-only ledger, deriving ts_ns and round_uuid from the sidecar filename and auto-including every criterion id it sees.
Re-running --record is idempotent using dedup key (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id), appending no duplicate firings on a stable corpus.

--report computes per-criterion detection_proxy (blocking fix-units later remediated to a PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (blocking fix-units the gate later de-escalated and never remediated) over a trailing window, with null rates when denominators are zero.
This within-review sidecar-only FP signal is deliberately distinct from and complementary to R7's outcome-corpus force-close/reopen blocking_fp_proxy, leaving R7's harness untouched.
The change does not modify the review hot path, keeping the verdict byte-identical and adding a doc-level promotion-gate protocol that R1/R3/R4 reference.
